text:
Tim Patel: Hey team! Tim here — day zero for me 🎉. Quick intro: I’m joining Platform as an SRE, based in Toronto. Big plant nerd (sunflowers) and iced coffee devotee. Small setup Qs below.
Jesse (People Ops): Welcome Tim!! :partyparrot: Buddy assigned — Rae from Platform will ping you. HR stuff should be in your inbox, lemme know if anything missing.
Tim Patel: Thanks Jesse! I see the MDM invite but my laptop profile failed to install. Getting an MDM error popup. Anyone from IT who can help?
Kai (IT): Hi Tim — I’m Kai from IT. Can you paste the exact error? Also can you try re-running the MDM enrollment from the web portal: https://mdm.redwood.corp/enroll? If that still fails, run the diagnostic below and paste output: ```/usr/local/bin/mdm-check --verbose```
Tim Patel: Error says "Profile installation failed: Device not supported". Ran mdm-check and it shows: "device_type: macbook_pro_14, os_version: 13.6.4, cert: pending". Pasting full output in DM to Kai.
Kai (IT): Got it — looks like the cert provisioning got stuck. I pushed a reissue, try the portal again. Also noted your machine model; we need a small config tweak for 14-inch MBP models. Should be fixed now.
Tim Patel: Portal worked! MDM installed, yay. Thanks Kai 🙏. One more: VPN and SSH to dev-k8s cluster — who do I request access from?
Rae (Platform): Hi Tim — I’ll add you to the platform-dev group and create an SSH key entry. Send me the public key when you have it. For VPN instructions, see https://docs.redwood.dev/internal/vpn and run: ```openvpn --config /etc/openvpn/redwood.ovpn``` or use the corporate MVPN client.
Tim Patel: Public key sent to Rae. Which channel do you usually ping for cluster help?
Rae (Platform): Use #eng-oncall for urgent cluster issues, #eng-platform for non-urgent questions. I’ll also add you to the weekly onboarding pairing sessions — we pair on a small ticket on Day 3.
Tim Patel: Sweet. Any sticker preferences for the laptop pack? I promise to trade sunflower stickers for any cool infra stickers :seedling:
Jesse (People Ops): We’ve got a little sticker stash — will send some ops-themed and a sunflower if we have it. Also welcome lunch next Friday if you want to join :)
infra-bot: Deploy bot: FYI one of the cluster test nodes will be rebooted tomorrow 02:00 UTC for kernel patching, expected downtime ~5m.
Tim Patel: Noted about the reboot — thanks infra-bot. Ok I think I’m mostly unblocked. Really glad to be here — excited to dive in and meet folks!
Rae (Platform): Welcome again, Tim. Ping me anytime @Rae for pairing or if you want a tour of our rollout dashboards.
Jesse (People Ops): Welcome aboard :thumbsup:
